name: Skolverket MCP
author: isakskogstad
description: Queries Swedish schools, curricula, subjects and education through Skolverket APIs. Runs locally from source; the former hosted service and npm package are unavailable.

quality.reason: Source review only; no runtime test or full rubric assessment. Build locally from source and run dist/index.js with node. The current README removes the retired remote service and unpublished npm package, so neither is advertised here. Standard configuration needs no key; SKOLVERKET_API_KEY is optional. Coverage overlaps MCP Sweden.
